accessToken: Short-lived sign-in credential sent as Bearer in the Authorization header to access your account.
activeWorkSeconds: Recorded time spent actively working, excluding breaks and pauses, within the reported scope.
afterId: Sibling work item to place the moved item immediately after.
archiveSha256: SHA-256 fingerprint of the compressed export archive for checking that downloaded bytes match.
archiveSizeBytes: Size of the prepared compressed export download; unavailable before the archive is built.
availableTimeSeconds: Time available for the suggested focus schedule, used to fit the recommendation into your current window.
beforeId: Sibling work item to place the moved item immediately before.
breakSeconds: Recorded time spent in break segments within the reported scope.
bucket: Whether chart totals are grouped into local calendar days or weeks.
bucketStart: Beginning of the local day or week represented by this chart point.
characteristicOverrides: Work-item-specific characteristics that replace matching defaults from its work type.
characteristics: Work-type defaults describing mental demand, interruption cost, continuity, repetition, physical activity and learning.
children: Direct child work items nested beneath this item, each with its own children where applicable.
choresCompleted: Distinct Chores completed through recorded session events within the reporting period.
clientOccurredAt: Optional time reported by the client for an event; retained separately from the authoritative server time.
code: Stable identifier for handling a Problem error or recognizing a recommendation reason without parsing its wording.
cognitiveDemand: How much sustained mental effort the work requires.
completedAt: When the work item or export request was marked completed; the containing object determines what finished.
completionRate: Share of ended sessions in this work-type group that completed rather than being abandoned; unavailable without ended sessions.
continuityNeed: How strongly the work benefits from staying in the same task without switching away.
createdAt: When this account, resource, device session, review or export request was first created.
ctx: Additional validation context, such as the limit or constraint that a submitted value failed.
current: Whether this listed sign-in session is the device session making the request.
current_revision: Observed migration state, including pending migrations when the database is behind; unavailable if it cannot be checked.
currentSegmentIndex: Zero-based position of the execution session's current segment; can reach the segment count after the final segment.
currentSegmentStartedAt: Server time used to track the current segment's running duration; may be absent between segments or after ending.
database: Whether the readiness check could successfully query the configured database.
deadlineAt: Latest intended completion time for this work item, including a timezone offset.
deletedAt: When this work item was soft-deleted and hidden from normal views; its database row is retained.
description: Optional longer explanation of the work item or work type beyond its short name.
detail: Explanation of a failed request, or the validation-error list in a validation response.
deviceName: Recognizable label for a signed-in device session, helping you choose which device to sign out.
difficultyScore: Your optional 1-to-5 rating of how difficult the session felt.
displayName: Human-facing name for an account or work type, depending on the containing object.
downloadUrl: Time-limited signed link to a ready, unexpired export archive; absent when no download is available.
durationMode: How a segment's duration is planned: fixed target, flexible target or open-ended.
effectiveCharacteristics: Resolved work characteristics after combining the work-type defaults with this item's overrides.
email: Account email address used for registration, sign-in, recovery and verification.
emailVerified: Whether the account has successfully confirmed control of its email address.
endedAt: When the execution session was completed or abandoned.
engineVersion: Version of the recommendation rules that produced this saved suggestion.
estimatedEffortSeconds: Your estimate of active work needed, used in planning and later comparison with recorded effort.
estimateErrorSeconds: Combined measured work time minus captured effort estimates for qualifying completed Chores in this item's scope; positive means longer than estimated.
event: The recorded session action returned together with the session state resulting from that action.
executeAfter: Earliest scheduled time for the worker to permanently delete the account after its grace period.
expected_revision: Migration targets expected by the running backend code.
expiresAt: When the containing device session or prepared export archive stops being valid.
expiresIn: Number of seconds until the issued access token expires.
failureCode: Stable explanation code for an export that failed generation; absent when no failure is recorded.
fatigueScore: Your optional 1-to-5 rating of how fatigued you felt after the session.
firstStartedAt: Earliest recorded active-work start found for this item or its historical descendants before the report's end.
focusPlanId: Saved focus plan selected for, or referenced by, an execution session.
focusScore: Your optional 1-to-5 rating of how focused you felt during the session.
from: Inclusive beginning of the analytics reporting period.
hasMore: Whether another page of matching results remains after this page.
hourStart: Local hour from 0 through 23 used to group activity patterns across days.
id: Identifier of the specific account, work item, type, plan, segment, recommendation, session or event represented here.
index: Zero-based position of a segment within its ordered focus plan.
input: Submitted value associated with a validation failure, when included in the error details.
instance: Request path where the reported Problem occurred.
instructions: Optional guidance on what to do during this focus-plan segment.
interruptionSensitivity: How disruptive an interruption is likely to be for this work.
items: The returned collection for this response, such as work items, plans, sessions, events or analytics groups.
kind: Category of the containing object: a work-item level such as Chore, or a plan-segment role such as work or break.
label: Short segment caption, or the evidence category attached to a recommendation reason, depending on context.
lastUsedAt: Last recorded use time of a sign-in session, updated when refresh credentials are renewed rather than on every API read.
learningMode: Whether the work involves no specific learning mode, acquiring information, recalling it or practicing a skill.
linkedWorkItemId: Chore assigned to this segment, limited to the plan's target Chore or a direct child of its target Sprint.
loc: Path to the invalid request value, using field names and list positions to locate the problem.
locale: Saved language or locale choice for the account's interface preferences.
maxSeconds: Optional upper duration bound for a plan segment.
medianEstimateErrorSeconds: Middle value of measured work time minus captured Chore estimates; positive means work typically took longer than estimated.
medianFocusScore: Middle value of available self-reported focus ratings for this analytics group.
medianStartDelaySeconds: Typical delay between captured planned start and first recorded work, treating early starts as zero delay.
medianUninterruptedWorkSeconds: Middle duration of the uninterrupted active-work blocks used by this report.
message: Plain-language explanation of why a focus recommendation was made.
meta: Extra structured Problem details, such as individual invalid fields or other error-specific context.
migration: Whether database migrations match the running code, are pending, or could not be checked.
minSeconds: Optional lower duration bound for a plan segment.
msg: Human-readable explanation of one validation failure.
name: Short human-facing name for a work item or saved focus plan.
newPassword: Replacement password supplied with a valid reset token; stored only as a password hash.
nextAction: Next eligible Chore or Sprint found in a Project's ordered tree, or null when none is available.
nextCursor: Opaque continuation value to send unchanged when requesting the next page.
note: Optional personal reflection about a completed or abandoned session.
occurredAt: Server-assigned time when the session event was accepted and applied.
optional: Whether this segment may be skipped; required segments cannot use the skip action.
p25UninterruptedWorkSeconds: Lower-quarter duration of qualifying uninterrupted work blocks; about a quarter are this short or shorter.
p75UninterruptedWorkSeconds: Upper-quarter duration of qualifying uninterrupted work blocks; about three quarters are this short or shorter.
page: Continuation information describing whether more results exist and how to request them.
parentId: Immediate parent work item; Projects have none, Sprints belong to Projects, and Chores may also be unparented inbox work.
password: Password supplied to register or prove account ownership at sign-in; never returned as account data.
pausedAt: When the execution session entered its current paused state; cleared when resumed or ended.
pausedSeconds: Recorded time spent paused, kept separate from active work and scheduled breaks.
payload: Event-specific supporting details, such as the Chore ID for a work-completion action.
physicality: How physically active the work is: sedentary, light or active.
plan: Proposed focus schedule stored inside a recommendation, before it is saved as a runnable focus plan.
planAdherenceRate: Completed nonoptional segments divided by planned nonoptional segments, including required breaks and transitions; unavailable when none were planned.
plannedStartAt: Intended start time for this work item, used when comparing planned and actual starts.
planSnapshot: Copy of the ordered plan captured when execution began, preserving that schedule despite later plan edits.
points: Chronologically ordered daily or weekly measurements for the activity chart.
position: Stored sibling-order value used to arrange work items; reordering may rebalance these numbers.
preferredStrategy: Requested or saved approach for recommendations: automatic choice, continuous work, structured blocks or flexible blocks.
preferredWorkBlockMaxSeconds: Preferred upper length of a work block used to guide future recommendations.
preferredWorkBlockMinSeconds: Preferred lower length of a work block used to guide future recommendations.
priority: Optional user-assigned work priority from 0 through 5; it does not replace saved sibling order.
provenance: Whether the suggestion came from baseline rules, user preferences or eligible personal history.
reasons: Saved explanations of the factors and evidence behind the recommended schedule.
recommendationId: Saved recommendation associated with a plan or execution session, preserving its suggested origin.
recommendationPersonalizationEligible: Whether this work-type pattern has enough qualifying history and review evidence to inform personalized recommendations.
recommendationSnapshot: Copy of recommendation inputs, proposed plan and reasons captured when the session started.
release_branch: Source branch recorded in build metadata for the running release, when available.
release_repository: Source repository recorded in build metadata for the running release, when available.
release_sha: Source commit recorded in build metadata for the running release, when available.
repetitiveness: How repetitive the work is, used to help choose an appropriate focus structure.
requestedAt: When the account-deletion request was recorded.
requestId: Export or deletion request identifier in job responses; HTTP request correlation identifier in a Problem response.
requiredSegmentsCompleted: Number of nonoptional segments completed in the relevant ended sessions, including required breaks and transitions.
requiredSegmentsPlanned: Number of nonoptional segments in the plans of the relevant ended sessions, including required breaks and transitions.
sampleSize: Number of distinct completed sessions contributing active work to this work-type focus pattern.
satisfactionScore: Your optional 1-to-5 rating of satisfaction with the session.
segmentIndex: Zero-based plan position associated with a segment or break event; must match the current segment for a new action.
segments: Ordered work, learning, break or transition blocks that make up the focus schedule.
session: The open execution session, or the resulting session after an event; may be null when no session is open.
sessionCount: Number of distinct sessions contributing to the particular item, work type or local-hour analytics group.
sessionId: Execution session to which this event or reflection belongs.
sessionsAbandoned: Sessions ended as abandoned during the reporting period.
sessionsCompleted: Sessions marked completed during the reporting period or chart bucket.
sessionStartedAt: Server time when the execution session was opened.
showReviewPrompt: Saved choice about showing a reflection prompt after a session.
slug: Short, stable work-type name used for category matching, including portable imports.
source: How the saved focus plan was created: manually, from a recommendation or as a template.
startedAt: When the worker began processing the export request.
state: Execution session stage: running, paused, completed or abandoned.
status: Entity-specific stage or health result; in a Problem response, the HTTP error status number.
strategy: Focus approach recorded with a plan snapshot, when available, such as continuous, structured or flexible.
system: Whether this is a shared built-in work type that users cannot edit or delete.
targetEndDate: Project's intended end date, distinct from a precise deadline timestamp.
targetSeconds: Planned duration to aim for in this segment; required for fixed and flexible duration modes.
targetStartDate: Project's intended start date, distinct from a precise planned-start timestamp.
template: Whether the plan is a reusable, unbound template rather than a plan that can execute directly.
timeOfDay: Activity and focus-rating patterns grouped by local hour across the reporting period.
timezone: IANA timezone used for saved preferences and local calendar or hourly analytics boundaries.
title: Short human-readable summary of a Problem error.
to: Exclusive end of the analytics reporting period.
token: One-time email verification or password-reset credential supplied to confirm the corresponding action.
tokenType: How to send the issued access credential; Bearer means placing it in the Authorization header.
type: Event action in session data, Problem-category URI in errors, or validation-rule identifier in individual validation failures.
updatedAt: When the containing resource was last recorded as modified.
user: Public account profile returned with newly issued sign-in credentials.
version: Resource revision used to track edits and form ETags; in release metadata, the backend package version.
weekStartsOn: Saved first-day-of-week setting used when grouping analytics into local calendar weeks.
workItemId: Work item targeted by the plan, recommendation, execution session or analytics result.
workTypeId: Work category assigned to an item or identified by an analytics group.
workTypeSlug: Stable work-type name identifying a historical analytics group, even when current category details change.
